_doc: Track R (2026-11-10) = research grants for the QNFO research programme; every R row starts unverified because the session network blocked the funders, and the weekly funding-maintenance run reads each at the source. Machine-readable funding registry. scripts/funding_verify.py reads it on a schedule (.github/workflows/funding-maintenance.yml) and files issues for stale, expiring or broken entries. Update last_verified only after reading the primary source. outreach:false on a row means the programme does not fit yet and the outreach engine skips it. status: verified = read at the primary source on last_verified; secondary = taken from a third-party summary; unverified = from memory or not reachable.

items.name: Sovereign Tech Fund
items.amount: min EUR 50,000 project cost; no max stated
items.notes: Open digital base technology only; OSI/FSF licence; no prototypes; user-facing apps not currently sought; about 6 months to contract. Fit: later, needs prevalence.

items.name: NLnet / NGI Zero Commons Fund
items.amount: not stated on page (typically EUR 5k-50k, unverified)
items.notes: Page is inconsistent: Aug 1 2026 deadline for two themed calls, 2027-01-03 per banner. Check the regular commons call and country eligibility.

items.name: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
items.notes: Rolling. Needs licence, demonstrated community traction and adoption, governance; max 2 applicants; 15 h programme. Fit: after public release and adoption.

items.name: Mozilla Foundation (Democracy x AI cohort, MOSS)
items.notes: 2026 cohort closed 2026-03-16 per third-party summary. Watch for the next call; civic framing needed.

items.name: Alfred P. Sloan Foundation (digital technology / open source)
items.amount: up to $750,000 over two years (2023 call)
items.notes: Read at sloan.org 2026-11-10: the open-source call found is the OSPO LOI for US higher-education institutions only, 2023 deadlines passed. Not applicable to a company; no other open Sloan call was found. Do not use in any pitch.

items.name: Ford / Mellon / Sloan digital infrastructure funders
items.notes: Research and ecosystem funders, mostly invitation. Not an application route today.

items.name: Open Technology Fund (FOSS Sustainability Fund and others)
items.notes: Internet-freedom scope only. Poor fit unless a censorship-resistance use case is built.

items.name: Humanity AI pooled fund open call
items.notes: Public-interest AI. Summer 2026 call; check for next round.

items.name: NSF POSE (Pathways to Enable Open-Source Ecosystems)
items.amount: Phase I up to $300,000 (1 yr); Phase II up to $1,500,000 (2 yr) under the archived NSF 24-606
items.notes: Read at nsf.gov 2026-11-10: NSF 24-606 is archived and replaced by NSF 26-506 (not read yet; read it before any outreach). Under 24-606 for-profit US-based, US-owned organizations were eligible; needs a US entity, so blocked on FUND-3 (entity). Not a current opportunity until 26-506 is read.

items.name: Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation)
items.amount: no cash stated; GitHub Enterprise and Cloudflare benefits
items.notes: Proposal via aaif/project-proposals; needs adoption, community, 6-12 month roadmap. Neutral-home option, later.

items.name: Apache Software Foundation Incubator
items.amount: not stated; the page names no funding for podlings
items.notes: Read at incubator.apache.org 2026-11-10: entry is a proposal after reading the cookbook and Incubation Policy; no eligibility criteria on the page; the Incubator accepts IP donations. Not a fit while the code is private and proprietary.

items.name: Open Source Collective (fiscal host)
items.amount: fee not stated on the application page or the acceptance criteria
items.notes: Read at opencollective.com and docs.oscollective.org 2026-11-10: needs an open source licence, an organisational (not personal) repository, a maintainer applicant, recent activity or usage; two or more administrators preferred. Terms of Fiscal Sponsorship (fee) not read. Not eligible while the repo is private and proprietary.

items.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
items.amount: USD 2,000 Start; up to 350,000 Scale AI
items.notes: Read at cloud.google.com/startup 2026-11-10 (Start USD 2,000; Scale AI needs verifiable venture funding; apply URL needs Google sign-in). Packet: business/funding/applications/google-for-startups/.

items.name: Cloudflare for Startups
items.notes: Tier 3 bootstrapped. Needs live site.

items.name: AWS Activate
items.amount: credits up to USD 200,000 (no tiers listed)
items.notes: Primary page read 2026-11-10; see credit-programs.md.

items.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
items.amount: Azure credits up to USD 150,000; up to USD 5,000 after verification
items.notes: Primary page read 2026-11-10; see credit-programs.md.

items.name: NSF SBIR/STTR (America's Seed Fund)
items.notes: Reauthorised through 2031-09-30 per third-party summary; nsf.gov not reachable. Requires US small business, mostly US-owned; Project Pitch first. Eligibility depends on where the entity is formed.

items.name: Y Combinator
items.notes: Fall 2026 deadline passed (2026-07-27). Next deadline not published as of verification. Public demo day.

items.name: Techstars
items.notes: Each programme publishes its own dates.

items.name: EIC Accelerator (EU)
items.notes: Cut-off 2026-11-04 per third-party tracker (passed). EU entity needed. Watch the next cut-off if the entity is EU.

items.name: NVIDIA Inception
items.notes: Primary page read 2026-11-10: no fees; incorporated, under 10 years, founder-operated. See credit-programs.md.

items.name: NWO (Dutch Research Council) open competition and Open Science funding
items.amount: Varies by call; eligibility usually needs a research institution affiliation (unverified)
items.notes: Netherlands-resident route for research. Check whether an independent applicant without an institution is eligible; if not, route through a host institution. Not read at the source: this session's network blocks the site.

items.name: EU Horizon Europe / ERC (research grants)
items.notes: EU research route open to Dutch residents. ERC and most Horizon calls need a host institution; check the Funding and Tenders portal for independent-researcher or small-actor calls. Not read at the source.

items.name: SIDN Fonds (Dutch internet fund)
items.notes: Dutch fund for projects that strengthen the internet; fit for open, public-benefit tooling. Check scope and whether an individual may apply. Not read at the source.

items.name: Schmidt Sciences (science and AI programmes)
items.notes: Private science funder; programmes are mostly by invitation or call. Check for an open call matching AI-for-science or open tooling. Not read at the source.

items.name: Astera Institute (open science and research tooling)
items.notes: Funds open research tooling and independent researchers. Check current programmes and how to apply. Not read at the source.

items.name: Foresight Institute grants
items.notes: Grant programmes for science and technology and AI; check current calls and the application route. Not read at the source.

items.name: John Templeton Foundation (funding inquiries)
items.notes: Science and big-questions funder with an online funding inquiry. Check fit for the research programme and eligibility. Not read at the source.

items.name: Open Philanthropy (how to apply)
items.notes: Publishes an application route for some programmes; check fit and exclusions. Not read at the source.

items.name: AI lab research-access and credit programmes for independent researchers
items.notes: Model API credit programmes for researchers exist at several labs; each needs its own page read and eligibility check before a packet is written. The exact program URL is not verified.

items.name: Center for Open Science and open-science funds
items.notes: Open-science infrastructure and meta-research funds; check whether current calls fit. Not read at the source.
